Own-product brand direction

Kepti

Useful should feel approachable.

The starting point

Useful should feel approachable.

A shop owner should not need an accounting vocabulary to understand their own business. Kepti’s brand starts at the counter: everyday words, clear records and a calm way to draw attention to something that needs checking.

The work covered

  • Brand foundation and audience
  • Identity and colour direction
  • Tone of voice and message patterns
  • Product expression and usage guidance

The decisions

A reason for
the choices.

Ledger green and warm paper make the system feel familiar. Saffron is a small signal for the next useful detail. The voice separates what is confirmed from what still needs checking, without talking down to the person using it.

  • #173D33
  • #F4F0E6
  • #E5A04B
  • #26312D

The words

Tell Kepti what happened. Know where you stand.

The first sentence makes the input feel manageable. The second makes the reason to do it clear. Both stay close to the owner’s working day.
